lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
viewer-init: 226 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/initial-state 205 B, vue-demi 13 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 8 B.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,691 B on the viewer-init page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
1,773 B in 5 pieces of 4 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (91 packages, 1,040 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in build is left without something that loads it.
